messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a single clearinghouse thread for the SDK/quickstart/sampleapp/docs release tomorrow. Need owner confirmations and any blocking PRs. Plan: changelog cutoff 16:00 PDT, code freeze 18:00 PDT, deploy window 21:00–22:30 PDT. Reply with your ownership and blockers. :eyes:

maria: I'm owner for python quickstart. No blockers, but I have two docs PRs that need a final review: `#1043` and `#1047`. Changelog entry ready in `docs/changes/py-quickstart.md`.

ben: I own JS sample app. There's one flaky test on CI (integration/embeddings) — I've got a fix in `#2115` but it's not merged yet. ETA for merge ~ 12:30 PDT.

sam: I'll take the Go SDK cutover. I need a heads-up if we exceed the changelog cutoff so I can rebase and rerun `go test ./...`. CI is green now but we have a dependency update that might cause a minor semver bump.

olivia: I'll coordinate the changelog consolidation across languages. Please drop your one-line bullets into the changelog PR `#2201` (in the changelog repo) before cutoff. If you can't make cutoff, ping me ASAP and I'll assess whether to include as post-release patch.

alex: checklist for owners (paste into thread as you confirm):
```
- Ownership: <name> (component)
- PRs blocking: list `#number`
- Docs ready?: yes/no + link
- Smoke test owner: <name>
- Post-release followups: list
```

ben: filling it out:
- Ownership: ben (js-sample)
- PRs blocking: `#2115` (integration test fix)
- Docs ready?: yes — `docs/js-sample/README.md`
- Smoke test owner: laura
- Post-release followups: monitor embedding regressions for 48h

maria: filling it out:
- Ownership: maria (py-quickstart)
- PRs blocking: none (just `#1043`, `#1047` pending reviews)
- Docs ready?: yes — `docs/quickstarts/python.md`
- Smoke test owner: sam
- Post-release followups: confirm pip packaging pipeline ran successfully

sam: filling it out:
- Ownership: sam (go-sdk)
- PRs blocking: `#309` (dependency bump)
- Docs ready?: partial — will finish doc patch by 14:00 PDT
- Smoke test owner: alex
- Post-release followups: check metrics for 24h, especially latency tail

laura: I'll handle smoke runs and release health dashboard. I'll trigger the smoke suite at +10m after deploy and post results here. If any major failures, I'll open an incident channel.

ci-bot: CI status — queued: `release/next` smoke, e2e, docs-link-check. Expected runtime ~ 35m. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/7890

alex: Two quick asks before we lock: (1) If you depend on a region-specific model variant, call it out now so we can route traffic during rollout. (2) If you need a canary longer than 30m, state why.

olivia: region note — py-quickstart uses `us-west-2` pinned model for perf testing, will be fine. No extended canary needed.

ben: canary request — need 45m for JS sample due to multiplayer load pattern test. Approving reduced ramp if needed.

alex: noted, planning: canary ramp to 10% for first 15m, 30% for next 30m, then full if green. ben — 45m OK, will tag you for manual hold.

maria: tagging reviewers: @laura @sam for final smoke sign-off, thanks.

alex: thanks all — I'll merge the consolidated changelog at cutoff and post the final PR number here. If anything changes urgently, reply in this thread or DM. :thumbsup:
